scripts.sprites: python3 -I tools/clean_sprites.py art/processed/player reference=art/raw/player/01-reference.jpeg idle=art/raw/player/02-idle.jpeg walk=art/raw/player/03-walk.jpeg shoot=art/raw/player/04-shoot.jpeg hurt-death=art/raw/player/05-hurt-death.jpeg && cp art/processed/player/idle.png art/processed/player/walk.png art/processed/player/shoot.png art/processed/player/hurt-death.png art/processed/player/player.json public/sprites/player/
scripts.enemies: python3 -I tools/extract_sprites.py art/processed/enemies 1-crawler=art/raw/enemies/1-crawler.jpeg@px=6.2@grid=6x6 1-spitter=art/raw/enemies/1-spitter.jpeg@px=5.8@grid=6x4 1-miner=art/raw/enemies/1-miner.jpeg@px=6.4@grid=6x3 && for n in crawler spitter miner; do cp art/processed/enemies/1-$n-strip.png public/sprites/enemies/$n.png; done
